answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 96 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is published against the quartz challenge, the beacon audit can replay the whisper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2449 identities would post 2221 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
